# FLX-3620: a consumer query or view is not a query

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

Only a SELECT, a set operation of them (UNION, INTERSECT, EXCEPT), or WITH before one is run. DDL, DML, PRAGMA, SET, ATTACH, COPY, INSTALL, LOAD, EXPORT, CALL, and anything sqlglot reads as a command, are refused. The message names the kind of statement found.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3620
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
